english: A weird doll? Don't tell me...
Not a customer. Is Sarutobi here?
Of course! Don't lump me in with that idiot!
An ex-Oniwaban ninja, all right. Where is he?
Th-this is a BOMB?! What an irritating face.
Come to think of it... Seen this thing somewhere before...
Blue, if I had to choose...
Then why ask in the first place?
Huh...? Then cut the blue one.
They're bringing these things into Kabukicho?
No time to waste! Gotta tell Kondo!
No, first find that florist, Hedoro!
Hey, did a customer leave this behind?
Um... These flowers were left beside the bomb.
Just left. Must still be around here.
Who knows? Back to his flower shop, maybe.
Hedoro just left. Probably still around.
No, not that. Just have some questions.
Hey, you kids... What's in your hands?
Saved your lives. Show some gratitude...
Handing them to kids too?! This is seriously bad...!
No time to disarm this! Find Hedoro first!
Some man I don't know gave it to me.
Didn't even want it. They were handing them out free.
Tch! Fine! Take the stupid doll!
You're the man from earlier... Something wrong?
Yes, that's it. Weird doll, isn't it?
Don't think so. They looked like ronin.
This the weird doll you saw at the delivery address?
But where IS Kondo...?\fThat place, I bet.
Dunno about Okita, but Kondo's most likely there.
It's called a Justaway. It's a bomb!
Remember! They were used in a case before!
An extremist Joi group! Let's go!
Weird doll. Seen it somewhere before...?
Was there a case like that?
Oh, yeah. There was a case like that.
Collect and dispose of them! Fast!
Abandoned building...? What kind of guys?
The guys handing these out are in that abandoned building?
What choice do I have?! Can't leave a bomb lying around!
Shabby ronin.\fHanding these things out... What are they thinking?
Joi rebels in a place like this?
Heard anything about Joi rebels around here?
Then I'll put them all in your pockets, Hijikata.
My pockets are full of all sorts of things.
It's dangerous! Just give it here!
Hey, Sougo. Quit playing. Let's go.
Hijikata. Gotta win it in a Gin Tama battle.
Now, sign that weird doll and hand it over.
Otsu. Don't take another one of these.
Hey, look! Cute, isn't it? Nightingale!
Funny little doll, huh? They were giving them out.
No! Want one? Go get your own!
Want it that much? Let's battle with Gin Tama!
What a shame... I really liked it...
Sorry if this is your second time seeing this!\fNow, everyone! Listen to my song as it's GAME OVER!
Might be a room somewhere. Look around.
Turning back now? The enemy's right under our noses.
Hey! Sougo! You ran off alone!\fThe elevator stopped! Had a hell of a time!
What the hell were you thinking?!
It's NOT all right!\fThis time, I really won't forgive you!
Wanna settle this with a battle?
That's Hijikata. Say what you like, he's strong...
Got time to act smug? Go look for them.
Shut up! Boys! Bring THAT out!
Y-you destroyed it?! What have you done?!\fI poured my love into that ultimate weapon of destruction!\fBoys! Crush them with Gin Tama!
Shut up! What's a criminal father supposed to do?!\fWhatever I do, my delinquent son will never straighten out...
We see right through your plan, bastard!
My men are finding the Justaways. Every last one.
